subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Should the Telegram plugin add a public channel/account parse or text-mode config, and which values and defaults should be supported across sends, captions, edits, and streaming previews?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but the fix adds public config surface and changes Telegram rendering, escaping, rich-message compatibility, and security posture.

options.title: Add narrow plain/html config
options.body: Support the current HTML-compatible default plus an explicit plain/no-parse mode with account inheritance and full outbound-funnel coverage.

options.title: Include MarkdownV2 or raw/entity modes
options.body: Add broader formatting choices, accepting larger review scope across MarkdownV2 escaping, raw HTML, custom emoji, and entity semantics.

options.title: Keep existing knobs only
options.body: Decline a parse-mode config and continue improving `richMessages`, `markdown.tables`, and targeted formatter behavior instead.

recommendation.title: Add narrow plain/html config
recommendation.body: Support the current HTML-compatible default plus an explicit plain/no-parse mode with account inheritance and full outbound-funnel coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for the rich-message opt-in gate and prior parse-mode product-review context.
